review: 702.88a-3: added; no scenario exercised rebound's 'if this spell was cast from your hand' condition. A Staggershock cast from exile through cascade goes to the graveyard, one cast from hand is exiled.

scenarios.title: A rebound spell cast from hand is exiled as it resolves
decisions: A casts Staggershock from hand targeting player B, tapping three Mountains.
B does not respond unless the variant says so; both players pass.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Staggershock resolves: B's life becomes 18. Instead of going to A's graveyard it is exiled, and A's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: In response, B casts Counterspell targeting Staggershock, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Staggershock is countered and goes to A's graveyard, not exile. B's life stays 20.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B casts Counterspell in response

detector.outcome: A resolving spell is put into exile instead of its owner's graveyard.
detector.near_miss: Not counted: without api only the fires side is tagged (the near miss would be a resolving spell put into the graveyard).

scenarios.title: A rebound card in exile may be cast for free at the next upkeep

setup.notes: Staggershock was exiled as it resolved from A's hand last turn, so its delayed rebound trigger waits for this upkeep.

decisions: The rebound delayed trigger goes on the stack at the beginning of A's upkeep and resolves.
A casts Staggershock from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting player B, unless the variant says otherwise.

variants.label: cast
variants.expected: Staggershock resolves: B's life becomes 16. Because it was cast from exile, it goes to A's graveyard and is not exiled again.

variants.label: declined
variants.delta: A chooses not to cast Staggershock.
variants.expected: Staggershock stays in exile and is never cast. B's life stays 18.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: A chooses not to cast Staggershock

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs the rebound delayed trigger to exist; reach the state by playing the previous turn's cast (702.88a-1) or by creating the delayed trigger explicitly.

detector.outcome: Rebound's delayed trigger fires at the beginning of its controller's next upkeep and lets them cast the exiled card.
detector.near_miss: Rebound's delayed trigger evaluated and not fired.

scenarios.title: Rebound applies only to a spell cast from its controller's hand

setup.notes: Staggershock is the only card in A's library.

decisions: A casts Bloodbraid Elf, tapping three Mountains and Forest.
The cascade trigger resolves: Staggershock (mana value 3) is exiled, and A casts it from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting player B.
Both players pass until the stack is empty.

variants.label: cast_from_exile
variants.expected: Staggershock resolves: B's life becomes 18. It was not cast from hand, so it goes to A's graveyard and is not exiled; no rebound trigger is created. Bloodbraid Elf is on the battlefield.

variants.label: cast_from_hand
variants.delta: Staggershock starts in A's hand instead of A's library, and A casts it from hand targeting player B, tapping three Mountains, instead of casting Bloodbraid Elf.
variants.expected: Staggershock resolves: B's life becomes 18. It is exiled instead of going to A's graveyard, and A's graveyard is empty.

operation.unclassifiable: more than one fact: the card moves from library to hand and A casts a different spell

scenarios.forge_notes: The top of A's library must be pinned to Staggershock.

detector.outcome: A resolving spell is put into exile instead of its owner's graveyard.
detector.near_miss: Not counted: without api only the fires side is tagged (the near miss would be a resolving spell put into the graveyard).
